first_playable.doc: First-playable flow (M2-FP-03; docs/kb/tech/first_playable_flow.md). field_battle: the scene BattleRequest opens and the party a field battle starts with when the request names none (active, reserve, rng seed). prologue: the cutscene the prologue plays and where it hands the party off. end_card: the minimum hold before ui_accept is taken, its fade-in, and the scene accept returns to (the title). haluna: what HalunaStory (game/flow/haluna_story.gd, M2-FP-04) plays in the playable zone: the cutscene on first arrival and its spawn, the field battle's return spawn and victory flag, and the scene the causeway-head trigger opens (Cutscene B on its placeholder set, then the end card).
